notes: Cai dat: tai file HPCONS-BIM-Setup-2.0.56.exe ben duoi, DONG Revit roi chay (can quyen Admin). - Mo mot mat dung / mat cat (hoac sheet co dat cac view do) roi bam: addin tu trien khai dim truc, dim level (dau level 2D, elbow, che nen am, tach chu dim nho) va ky hieu vat lieu (tu dat ten ky hieu) trong 1 lan bam, 1 lan Undo. - Thanh phan da co trong view duoc giu nguyen, khong dat trung. Chua co: ky hieu do doc mai, tag cua, cao do diem. - Cac nhip nho (<= 300 mm) ke nhau ma chu keo len se de len nhau: nhip duoi cung keo chu XUONG, nhip tren keo len. - Ban ve da dim bang ban truoc: chay lai Dim Level tren view do la chu tu tach. Chu da tu dat cho khac duoc giu nguyen.
